road_text._doc: Big painted street-name decals at each turn-onto. mode 'along' = lengthwise down the lane (drive over it, head-tilt to read); 'across' = sign-flat facing the driver (wraps the road type to a 2nd line). cap_m = letter height across the road. flip_read/flip_up mirror the axes if it reads backwards in-game. min_leg_m = shortest street leg that gets a label.

road_profile._doc: Hand-authored elevation/camber drama (the Sand Creek corkscrew). Stations are metres along the lap in build_mesh's smoothed frame; the Sand Creek Dr entry (E 56th -> Sand Creek, a right-hander) is at ~3465 m. dip depth_m LOWERS the centerline; bank_deg rolls the road (+ve banks a RIGHT-hander: outside/left edge up, inside/right edge down). Tune by feel.
